passages.note: Irwin voted Aye on Assembly concurrence in Senate amendments, the final Assembly vote on the chaptered text; 16 of 77 voting were No, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Chaptered text voted on in concurrence; a single-subject LGBTQ pupil-rights bill whose operative Section 220.5 forbids rules requiring disclosure, while imposing no duty on staff to withhold (so not rung 1).

rows.reasoning: Irwin voted Aye (61-16) on final Assembly concurrence in AB 1955 (2023-2024), whose operative Section 220.5 says a school district or school board member "shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose" a pupil's gender identity without the pupil's consent, which matches the rung "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents." The bill only says staff "shall not be required to disclose"; it does not require staff to keep the information from parents, so the rung "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents" is not shown.
